en: The Fourth Adhyāya of the Fourth Aṣṭaka.

The excellent qualities of Mitra and Varuṇa.
The individual special qualities and deeds of Varuṇa.
Description of the individual nature of Mitra.
The relation of the principle of water to Varuṇa.
The application (viniyoga) of the sūkta, and the seer, deity and metres.
